headline: Public march counters pro-deportation event in central Indiana
summary: About 1,000 Hoosiers supportive of immigrants protested in Fishers on Aug. 1, 2026, against a planned pro-deportation event organized by Save Heritage Indiana and headlined by former Border Patrol leader Greg Bovino. The protest was eventually cut short due to lightning, but speakers including Sen. Fady Qaddoura likened the mass deportation rally to historic anti-immigrant groups like the Ku Klux Klan.

headline: Will Caron: Troubled Waters
summary: The state faces a projected $1.4 billion budget shortfall for fiscal year 2023 due to lower-than-expected revenue and increased expenses from the pandemic. To balance the budget, the governor proposed cuts to various departments, including education and health, sparking public outcry. Lawmakers are considering alternative solutions such as tapping into rainy day funds or increasing taxes on corporations and high-income individuals.
